checks.name: Native export preserves game raw values and excludes unrelated credentials
Import, unchecked groups and preview are read-only until an explicit decision
Before-copy download then native confirmation restores only the chosen group
Corrupted imports and malformed copies cannot overwrite a good local group
An actual second browser tab invalidates a stale preview via the storage event
A quota error on a later write rolls back earlier keys with an honest failure message
Native keyboard navigation, mobile layout and cancellation preserve the session
The Excel link downloads the exact shipped tracking workbook
